message.text:
q19.

ConnectRPC (which also accepts gRPC/gRPC-Web on the same routes) — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`, with the per-method wrappers in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`
REST via grpc-gateway — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`

The Connect side registers generated handlers on an `http.ServeMux`:

```40:40:server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go
		wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)),
```

`ConnectServiceHandler` embeds `*APIV1Service` and each method in `connect_services.go` unwraps `connect.Request`/rewraps `connect.Response` around the same business logic.

The REST side binds the gateway handler in-process (no separate gRPC dial) and mounts it on the Echo group at `/api/v1/*`:

```108:110:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	if err := v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
		return err
	}
```

The route table for that path mapping is the generated `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`.
